title: lichen-node: clippy -D warnings fails on pre-existing send_secure_block1 too_many_arguments
description: cargo clippy -p lichen-node --features std --all-targets -- -D warnings fails with clippy::too_many_arguments (8/7) on SecureStack::send_secure_block1 (rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs:642, async fn with dst, peer_iid, ... 8 args). Pre-existing lint, not introduced by worker6-12zy (announce_store.rs is lint-clean). Fix by grouping args into a struct or #[allow] with justification.
